newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier after BULOG move.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier after BULOG move.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were easier in late trading on Tuesday after the state logistics agency BULOG commenced market operations to cut olein prices.
Traders said palm olein was quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,455-60 rupiah at the opening. Crude palm oil offers were heard at 1,225-30 rupiah/kg.

A BULOG spokesman confirmed the commencement of market operations on Tuesday and added that the move was aimed at keeping prices under control ahead of the Moslem Ramadan fasting month that starts later this week. He said the agency was selling olein at 1,300 rupiah per litre.
